title: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive — Buenos Aires, 20 September, 2015–2025
claims: For Buenos Aires on 20 September in 2015–2025, there are 11 daily records: daily maximum 14.4–25.6 °C (median 18.8 °C), daily minimum 5.7–15.3 °C (median 10.7 °C), 2 days with at least 1 mm precipitation and 1 day with at least 5 mm.
The station is a city station; the race is a flat urban course with no published total elevation gain.

verification.note: Daily values retrieved and filtered to 20 September; medians and wet-day counts calculated locally.

claimVerification.note: Coordinates from API; no elevation figure in official regulations or map.
